prompt: CHALLENGE: You need to make 4-aminobenzoic acid (p-amino) from toluene. What is the correct order of transformations?

options.label: Nitrate (gets p-NO₂ because CH₃ is o/p director) → oxidize CH₃ to COOH (KMnO₄, heat) → reduce NO₂ to NH₂ (Sn/HCl)
Reduce the nitro group first — fails because there's no nitro to reduce yet
Oxidize to COOH first; now NO₂ goes meta, giving the wrong isomer

explanation: CH₃ is o/p director — do EAS nitration while CH₃ is still there to get para-NO₂. Then oxidize CH₃ to COOH (now a meta director, but we're done with EAS). Finally reduce NO₂ → NH₂. Doing the ox first would put NO₂ meta.
